summary: Full-stack application built successfully with all modules implemented: shared types package, Express BFF backend with mock data service, and React SPA frontend. All 37 tests pass across both packages.

bugs.description: Mock data is module-level and shared across test runs; concurrent tests could have state leakage
bugs.expected: Each test should have isolated state
bugs.actual: Mock invoice/client arrays are mutated in-place across the module lifecycle

bugs.description: Period select uses 'all_time' as a workaround for empty string value in SelectItem, which could cause minor UX confusion
bugs.expected: Empty string value handled natively by Select component
bugs.actual: Value 'all_time' is mapped to undefined in onValueChange handler

bugs.description: Session store setup is async but the session middleware is applied before the store is ready if the DB connection takes time
bugs.expected: Session store should be ready before requests are served
bugs.actual: sessionStore variable may still be undefined when session middleware initializes
